fields.title: Reset Password
fields.question: How do I reset my password?
fields.answer: Choose Forgot your password? on the sign-in page and follow the link we email you.

fields.title: Account Page
fields.question: Where can I update my account details?
fields.answer: Open your account page from the profile menu and edit your name, email, and preferences.

fields.title: Contact Support
fields.question: How do I contact support?
fields.answer: Use the contact form, or email support@example.com and we will reply within one business day.

fields.title: Support Hours
fields.question: What are your support hours?
fields.answer: Support is available Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm.

fields.title: Update Card
fields.question: How do I update my card on file?
fields.answer: Edit your payment method on the billing page and save the new card details.

fields.title: Refunds
fields.question: How do I request a refund?
fields.answer:
Refunds are processed within 30 days.

Contact billing for help.

fields.title: Draft FAQ
fields.question: How can I verify the draft preview path?
fields.answer: Open the FAQ list and use the preview action on the draft row.
